svg.text: PART A - 1 ms prescaler (shared by all four counters)
PART B - one cooldown channel (instantiate 4x: P1 shoot, P1 special, P2 shoot, P2 special)
PART C - MMIO write decode (TIMER_TRIGGER) and read (TIMER_STATUS)
Part A: shared 1 ms tick. Part B: one down-counter (x4). Part C: trigger decode + status read. All registers: sync reset to 0.
tick = 1 also restarts the prescaler at 0, so tick period = CLK_PER_MS clocks (50_000 @ 50 MHz)
bit0 P1 shoot bit1 P1 special
bit2 P2 shoot bit3 P2 special
-> Fig 2b read mux (cs_tmr_q). C code: if (TIMER_STATUS & 1) fire();
no busy-wait loop; the CPU only samples ready bits once per frame.
